summary: SS Innovations International, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) on June 18, 2026, regarding an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $50,000,000 of its common stock through Virtu Americas LLC as agent. The stock trades on Nasdaq under SSII; the prior day's closing price was $3.29 per share. Virtu will receive up to 3.0% commission on gross proceeds, with no escrow or trust arrangement. The filing is a routine capital raise under Rule 415(a)(4), not a special situation. No deal terms applicable; focus is on market-price sales over time.
